categories.description: Loft and warehouse language with masonry and steel expression

categories.description: Warm minimal palettes and human-scaled contemporary blocks

categories.description: Arcades, stucco and stone palettes, and shaded public edges

categories.label: Futuristic
categories.description: Forward-looking forms and advanced envelope language

categories.description: Stepped vertical composition with ornamental crown detail

categories.description: Regionally rooted forms and local material expression

categories.description: Boulevard-scaled stone facades with balcony continuity
